By using PromptLens you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the app. You must be at least 13 years old to use PromptLens.

PromptLens provides photography inspiration and image-generation prompts for personal and creative use. You agree not to misuse the app. This includes copying or scraping content in bulk, trying to break, overload or disrupt the app or its servers, trying to access data that is not yours, using the app for anything unlawful, or tricking the ads or reward system.

Some features, such as revealing a prompt, may require you to watch a short ad. Ads are provided by Google AdMob. Signing in is optional and is needed only for features such as likes and comments. You are responsible for keeping your account secure.

You can post comments after signing in. Keep discussions respectful. Spam, harassment, hate speech, threats, adult content, advertising, and abusive or illegal comments are not allowed. You are responsible for what you post, and you give PromptLens permission to display your comments in the app.\n\nYou can report comments you find inappropriate. We may remove comments and limit or suspend accounts that break these rules, at any time and without notice.

Content: the images, titles and prompts shown in PromptLens are provided for inspiration. Rights to the original content remain with PromptLens and the respective creators. You may copy a prompt and use it with AI tools to create your own artwork, but you may not republish the app content as your own collection or claim it as your own.

Third-party tools: PromptLens may link to third-party AI tools and websites. They are separate services that we do not own or control, we are not affiliated with them, and their own terms and privacy policies apply when you use them.

No guarantee: the app and its content are provided as is and as available, without any promise of results, accuracy or uninterrupted service. To the fullest extent allowed by law, PromptLens and its operator are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the app or from images you create using the prompts.

Changes and ending: we may update the app and these terms from time to time, and continuing to use the app means you accept the changes. We may suspend or end access for anyone who breaks these terms. You can stop using the app and delete your account at any time.

Contact: farhadvarietiesstore@gmail.com

1. Who We Are and What We Collect

PromptLens is operated by Farhad Variety Store (we, us, our). PromptLens is an app for browsing AI image inspiration and prompts. This Privacy Policy explains what information the app uses, why, and what choices you have. By using the app you agree to this policy.

Information you provide: if you choose to sign in with Google, we receive your Google account name, email address and profile photo. If you post a comment, we store the comment and your display name. You can also use the app as a guest without signing in.

Information collected automatically: an anonymous guest ID created by Firebase Authentication; your likes, saved posts and unlocked prompts; basic device and app information (device model, Android version, app version, language and approximate region); app usage, crash and performance data; a notification token used to send notifications you allow; and your advertising ID when ads are shown.

We do not collect your precise location, contacts, microphone or camera data, or the photos stored on your device.
2. How We Use and Share Information

We use your information to run the app, show your saved posts, likes and comments, remember which prompts you unlocked, send notifications you allow, keep the app secure, prevent abuse, understand how the app is used so we can improve it, and show ads.

The app relies on Google services: Firebase (Authentication, Firestore database, Analytics, Cloud Messaging, App Check) for accounts, storage and notifications, Google Sign-In for optional sign-in, and Google AdMob for advertising. These services process your data for us and under their own privacy policies. AdMob may use your advertising ID and device information to show and measure ads. Where the law requires it, we ask for your consent before showing personalized ads, and you can review your choice at any time from Privacy choices in the Profile screen.

We do not sell your personal information. We do not share it with anyone except these service providers, or when required by law or to protect our users and the app.

We keep your information only while your account exists or while it is needed to provide the app. Anonymous guest data and usage data are kept for a limited time by the services described above.
3. Your Choices, Deletion, Security and Children

Your choices: you can use the app without signing in, sign out at any time, delete your own comments, turn off notifications in your phone settings, and reset or delete your advertising ID in Android settings.

Account deletion: you can delete your account at any time from Profile, then Delete account. This removes your account, profile, saved posts, likes and comments from our systems. You can also ask us to delete your data by emailing the address below, and we will respond within a reasonable time.

Your rights: depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information, or to object to its use. Contact us and we will help.

Security: data is sent over encrypted connections and stored with Google Firebase security protections. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

International use: your information may be processed on servers in countries other than your own, by the Google services described above.

Children: PromptLens is for a general audience and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or want to request access to or deletion of your data, contact us at farhadvarietiesstore@gmail.com.

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the date below, and where the change is important we will tell you in the app. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated policy.
